en-US.name: Addy Agent Skills
en-US.summary: 25 selectable engineering skills for specification, development, testing, review and release. Browser checks need Chrome DevTools MCP. Provide scripts’ runtimes and deployment tools as required by the selected skill.
en-US.description:
Lists the 25 skills in the canonical skills/ directory of release 0.6.15. Choose individual skills and retain their upstream IDs and paths. Localized summaries aid discovery. The market copies selected skill directories, including their own files. Host plugins, workflow commands, subagents and repository-level references/ remain separate. Consult references/ at the same pinned snapshot when a workflow points to a shared checklist.

Browser testing requires a separately configured compatible Chrome DevTools MCP server, Chrome and appropriate access. Optional constraint and idea-refinement scripts require Node.js and Bash respectively. Check the Git, test, CI/CD, deployment, credential and access requirements for the task. External services retain their own terms and costs. Review scripts and arguments before execution. Skip or stop affected steps when prerequisites are missing and report incomplete verification. Obtain appropriate authorization before pushing, deploying or sending data to an external service. Review covers pinned source, inventory, metadata, prerequisites and license. Runtime and cross-platform behavior remain untested.

zh-CN.name: Addy 软件工程技能合集
zh-CN.summary: 25 个可按需选择的软件工程技能，涵盖规格、开发、测试、评审和发布。浏览器检查需另配 Chrome DevTools MCP，脚本和部署工具按所选技能准备。
zh-CN.description:
收录 0.6.15 发行版规范 skills/ 目录中的 25 个子技能。按需选择，保留上游 ID 和目录路径。市场中文摘要用于发现技能，安装的正文沿用上游内容。市场安装复制所选技能目录及其中的文件，宿主插件、工作流命令、子 Agent 和仓库级 references/ 不在安装范围内。某些流程引用共享清单时，请在同一固定快照的 references/ 中查阅。

浏览器测试需另配兼容的 Chrome DevTools MCP、Chrome 和对应权限。约束检查与创意澄清的可选脚本分别需 Node.js 和 Bash。按任务核对 Git、测试框架、CI/CD、部署环境、凭据和权限。外部服务适用各自条款和费用。执行脚本前阅读其内容并核对参数，缺依赖时跳过或停止相关操作，并说明未完成的验证。推送、部署或向外部服务传输数据需相应授权。审核覆盖固定来源、清单、元数据、依赖说明和许可，实际运行及跨平台表现尚未验收。

requirements.value: 需支持 Agent Skills 的宿主。可选脚本分别需要 Node.js 或 Bash，测试与构建工具按目标项目准备。 / Requires an Agent Skills host. Optional scripts use Node.js or Bash. Supply project-specific testing and build tools.

浏览器测试另配 Chrome DevTools MCP 和 Chrome。部署和观测按项目另配服务，遵循各自条款和费用。 / Browser testing needs separately configured Chrome DevTools MCP and Chrome. Deployment and observability services follow their own terms and costs.

实际执行前核对工具版本、参数和权限。缺依赖时停止相关步骤并说明影响。推送、部署和数据外传需授权。 / Verify versions, arguments and permissions before execution. Stop affected steps when prerequisites are missing and explain the impact. Obtain authorization for pushes, deployments and external data transfers.
